description: Implementation of socket waiter using libevent for asynchronous socket event handling, including socket acceptance, event registration, and wake-up mechanisms.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate
classes.description: Private implementation of a socket waiter using libevent, managing socket events, wake-up signals, and internal state.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate
methods.description: Constructor initializing event base, wake-up mechanism, and socket pipes or sockets.

methods.name: ~SbSocketWaiterPrivate
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources, removing waiters, and closing sockets or pipes.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Registers a socket with the waiter for specified interests and callback.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a socket from the waiter's monitoring.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Blocks indefinitely until an event occurs.

methods.name: WaitTimed
methods.description: Blocks for a specified duration or until woken up.

methods.name: WakeUp
methods.description: Signals the waiter to wake up, optionally indicating a timeout.

methods.name: HandleSignal
methods.description: Handles socket events and invokes callbacks.

methods.name: HandleWakeUpRead
methods.description: Handles wake-up signals from the pipe or socket.

methods.name: AddWaitee
methods.description: Adds a socket event watcher to internal map.

methods.name: GetWaitee
methods.description: Retrieves a waitee for a socket.

methods.name: RemoveWaitee
methods.description: Removes and returns a waitee for a socket.
